result.brief: 提出 PEWAM 世界-动作模型，将演示编译为效果程序（物体 3D 关键点轨迹与终态），以独立流匹配时间生成效果、执行、动作与终态四流，实现可编程、跨机械臂的闭环机器人控制。
result.reason: World-action model generating effect/execution/action/terminal-state streams via flow matching; robot policy and control is the main contribution, matching the secondary world-model applications direction.
